notes: Page shows one full box score (sheet labeled 'Game 19', Feb 6 1988, Ohio State at Northwestern, Welsh-Ryan Arena). Team totals rows (with team-level FG/FGA/3FG/3GA/FT/FTA/A/TO/BK/S/MIN) were used to cross-validate and, for a few players, deduce exact FG/FT/points/PF by subtraction from the team total minus the other 7 confirmed players (this resolved a garbled Terry Buford row and an ambiguous PF/points split for Jeff Grose). Individual points (pts) equal the sheet's printed TP column where legible, verified against 2*(FG-3FG)+3*3FG+FT; both team checksums pass exactly (OSU players sum to 65, Northwestern players sum to 59; MIN sums to 200 for both teams). Rebound (reb), assist/turnover/steal/block (ast/to/stl/blk) fields are omitted for individual Northwestern players and for two Ohio State players (Perry Carter, Grady Mateen) because the OR/DR/REB/PF column group and, for Northwestern, the A/TO/BK/S column group had internal inconsistencies against the team totals row (e.g. summed blocks for Northwestern players came to ~7 vs. a team total of 3) that could not be resolved without inventing values, per instructions to omit rather than guess. Northwestern PF values ARE included because they were fully reconciled against the team PF total (sums to 21).
